head.title: Book a fit
head.text: Tell us what you need and when you can come. We'll confirm a time within one business day and send the questionnaire. Prefer to talk first? Email info@fitworksstudio.com.

slotsHint: Morning and afternoon slots on each day. Fits start at 9:00am and 5:00pm
notesLabel: What's going on with your riding?
notesPlaceholder: What hurts, what you ride, and what you'd like to change. Short is fine.
paymentNote: No payment now. You pay when the session is confirmed.
successText: We'll email you a confirmed time within one business day, along with the pre-fit questionnaire. If you don't hear from us, email info@fitworksstudio.com.

cards.title: The studio
cards.note: Free parking at the door. Bring the bike in with you.

cards.title: Before your fit
lines: Complete the questionnaire we send you
Wear your kit and bring your shoes
Eat beforehand. You'll be pedalling for a while.
